title: Wire capture→render Brain-B cores into the live GPU/iOS pipeline (item 1 first)
summary: Operator wiring for the capture→render Brain-B cores already on main (AUTH #049/#050; design/proposals/capture-render-quality-v1.md + external-synthesis-builds.md batch 2). Item 1 only in this first slice: pass render_quality.splatfacto_quality_args(config) into ns_train_capped, confirm Splatfacto flag strings against pinned nerfstudio 1.1.5, prepare the antialiased+mcmc vs classic+default corpus A/B with a cost estimate before any GPU spend, then flip ReconstructionConfig defaults only after the A/B. Items 2–10 stay out of scope until item 1 lands. Non-commercial weights never ship (#049). VGGT/Metric3D wait on counsel (#050).
scope_out: Items 4–10 of capture-render-quality-v1 (BAD-Gaussians, Splatfacto-W, MapAnything, delivery, VGGT, Metric3D, FisherRF coaching); items 2+3 (DN-Splatter losses, Depth Anything V2 Small prior) entered scope 2026-10-06 per the Owner assignment relayed by the parent, code+tests first, default off
Shipping non-commercial weights (Depth Anything non-Small, UniDepth, DUSt3R/MASt3R/Fast3R, academic Inria 3DGS forks)
Shipping VGGT / Metric3D weights before counsel confirms (#050)
Flipping ReconstructionConfig defaults before the corpus A/B completes
deliverables: qa/evidence/M1-PIPE-03/item1-ab-plan.json (A/B plan + cost estimate; no GPU until headroom confirmed)

acceptance_tests.test: GsplatTrainer passes render_quality.splatfacto_quality_args(config) into the ns-train half of ns_train_capped, and densify_strategy=mcmc (or the quality-30k-mcmc profile) passes --mcmc-cap into the own-args half.
acceptance_tests.evidence: unit tests in test_trainer.py / test_render_quality.py + code reference

acceptance_tests.test: render_quality.py documents the exact Splatfacto flag strings confirmed against pinned nerfstudio 1.1.5 (rasterize-mode classic|antialiased is a real CLI flag; --pipeline.model.strategy is NOT in 1.1.5 — MCMC stays on install_mcmc via --mcmc-cap).

A/B plan for antialiased+mcmc vs classic+default on the corpus is written with a Modal cost estimate before any GPU spend; the run stays inside existing caps (Modal $20/mo, #031/#039/#040/#045, $50/day halt) or an AUTH REQUEST is filed first.
ReconstructionConfig defaults are flipped to the A/B winner only after the corpus A/B metrics are recorded; bedroom private data used only under AUTH #046 (metrics/text in git).

auth_required.what: Commercial-safe capture→render stack (gsplat antialiased + MCMC densification among others). Logged AUTH #049.

Bedroom classic-default 24.93/0.939/0.126 vs antialiased-default 24.85/0.942/0.124 vs mcmc 24.10/0.930/0.171. Spend ~$4.77 run records / ~$5.14 container-time est (hard stop $7). Next: antialiased-default single-factor arms (~$2.2) need a fresh go. Evidence: qa/evidence/M1-PIPE-03/item1-ab-results.json.

Items 2+3 A/B (5 runs, 19:17-19:39 CT): shipping recipe vs + Depth Anything V2 Small prior + depth/normal losses on Winchester, Eldon House and the bedroom (#046). Fails the pre-registered rule on every room (LPIPS +0.225/+0.241/+0.042; PSNR -3.57/-5.39/-0.53 dB) -> depth_prior stays 'none'. Floater proxy -47%/+9%/-48%; bedroom Unity path improves 21.71 -> 22.10 dB. Two of four corpus rooms only (budget). Spend $3.11 run records; Modal October ~$15.8-16.3 (hard stop $16.50 not passed). Fixed ns_finish geometry renders (pipeline.eval()) and the empty Unity dicts in item1-ab-results.json.

Depth prior CPU check (no GPU): prior is inverse depth (Spearman +0.56 Winchester / +0.93 bedroom); bedroom fits an affine inverse-depth model (R^2 0.91-0.996 on 6/8 frames), Winchester is unreliable on 4/8 frames (R^2 <= 0.26) -> main cause with weights/start. Undistortion misalignment real but small (p95 2.0 px / 4.9 px) -> fixed: prior_alignment.align_map_to_nerfstudio applied at cache build. Retry knobs (depth_prior_weight_scale, depth_prior_start_step) + render_ab arm antialiased-default-dn-soft (0.25 / 4000) wired, not run. Evidence: qa/evidence/M1-PIPE-03/depth-prior-cpu-check.json.
